gold: Carcinoma erysipelatoides arising from triple-negative breast cancer

selector.rationale: The presence of multiple emboli of carcinoma cells in dermal and subcutaneous lymphatic vessels supports Carcinoma Erysipelatoides, which is a rare skin manifestation of metastatic cancer.

rejected.label: Inflammatory Breast Cancer
rejected.why: The patient's history and clinical presentation do not align with Inflammatory Breast Cancer, which typically presents with rapid onset of erythema and edema of the breast skin.

rejected.label: Radiation Dermatitis
rejected.why: While the patient has a history of radiotherapy, the clinical presentation and biopsy findings are not consistent with Radiation Dermatitis, which typically presents with skin changes such as erythema, dry desquamation, and moist desquamation within the radiation field.
